KNOCK OUT

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
Paulo de Barros is a French and Portuguese national. He came to South Africa in 2018 to work at a tech company providing internet access via Opera. They provided access specifically to those who cannot afford it – they became the browser of choice in Africa for 100m people. Then 2 years ago he was assaulted one evening in Bantry Bay, hit in the head and nearly died.

• He sustained a skull fracture, brain hemorrhage, brain contusion and nose fracture – and permanent brain damage. He also had permanent hearing loss (Autophony – person's own speech or other self-generated noises (e.g. heartbeat, eye movements, creaking joints, chewing) are heard unusually loudly in the affected ear; Dizziness/ vertigo/ chronic disequilibrium caused by the dysfunction of the superior semicircular canal; Tullio phenomenon – sound-induced vertigo, disequilibrium or dizziness, nystagmus and oscillopsia; Pulse-synchronous oscillopsia; Hyperacusis – the over-sensitivity to sound; Extreme sound distortion ( broken stereo); A feeling of fullness in the affected ear, Pulsatile tinnitus; Brain fog ;Fatigue ;Headache/migraine; Tinnitus – high pitched ringing in the ear

Brain damage

This means for the past 2 years he couldnt anywhere where there is noise, noise became his “handicap, it's everywhere. I haven't been able to travel, socialize or even go to restaurants or malls without suffering… I simplify cannot live a normal life since then. I basically do nothing all day and most of the days besides sitting at home and working in front of my computer… Since then I have had a limited life, reduced to being always alone where there is no noise.”

He knew something was wrong, but no one listened to him, so he went to France to see a specialist and he was then diagnosed with Semicircular canal dehiscence (SCD) which is a crack of the fracture that never healed, sustained by the attack which is the root/source of all the problems. I am now awaiting for surgery from a Professor in Belgium.
This is so rare, that he is likely the only person currently living with this extreme rare disorder – most people are sent into a vegetative state.

The surgery requires the doctors to open his skull, fill in the gap with a bony material taken from other parts of his skull to plug the defect and then resurface the area. Then his skull is glued back together. The recovery for this is a month – he will be put into a coma, and then woken up.
You can see the crack – very hard to diagnose
His surgery is going to take place towards the end of March. And his life hangs in the balance.
So how did this happen? And why?
It all began that fateful night when he was assaulted. Obviously in the hospital, Paulo was reliant on his friend and the police to investigate. Paulo’s friend said that the Sea Point Police officer assigned the case M. Mgolozeli denied that anything happened after visiting the house and was going to dismiss the case, but then Paulo hired a PI – Ben from Unisure who collected the video of the incident and got affidavits from all the witnesses present – all of which point the finger at one man. A 25 year old from St. Johns named Gino Sanchez.
The video shows Gino walking up to de Barros (randomly) and gino punches him in the face, then twice more while he’s unconscious on the floor. For the 2 hours before the incident from when De Barros arrived, the two of them never spoke or interacted according to the CCTV we have. There was no explanation as to why Sanchez beat him. And none has been forthcoming.


Summary:
Please view the video here: please watch in file
Who is Gino?
His father, Jo Sanchez, runs a construction company https://www.sanjo.co.za/ with alleged ties to organizations such as Cosatu https://www.sanjo.co.za/clients/, who have a lot of political influence in South Africa. They live a life of luxury ferarri’s, yachts, trips to Greece…

After the case and all evidence being collected including video footage of the assault and medical reports, the case was assigned to Prosecutor Mr David Jacobs.
Despite the video evidence showing Gino, the affidavits confirming it was him, the prosecutor declined to prosecute without providing any reason. Then de Barros hired lawyer William Booth – well known criminal attorney. He questioned the NPA. Prosecutor David Jacobs then lost the docket, but then when he found out there were hard copies, the docket re-appeared. With Booth’s intervention the NPA decided to prosecute Gino for attempted murder on one count. (I have the email)… But its been over a year, and Gino still haven’t had his day in court, because they didn’t arrest him. They sent him a subpoena to appear in court, and the police say they haven’t been able to serve it on him because Gino is in Johannesburg – and doesn’t live in cape town. The police are just dragging their feet, and Booth has now asked for an arrest warrant – which is yet to be signed by the NPA.

The PI is willing to speak, Booth, Charl Norman who was with de Barros is willing to speak, we have the affidavits of the witnesses and we can call them (ive been hesitant because these kids are gino’s social group – despite them giving evidence saying he did it) We would obviously confront Gino – we know where he lives. But his dad’s house is in a complex near sandton city. We have MANY pictures of Gino and his family. All the evidence and affidavits is in the folder provided.



Further information:
The operation just happened on 23rd march - and it was a success. His belgium professor will speak with us, we also have videos from him of his time before op and after - like a video diary. Then we got great news - the warrant of arrest has finally been signed! NOT EXECUTED YET... SO now is the time to do it...

Flights to cape town
Potentially a camera man in france

Script:


VO: Cape Town: tourist hotspot and a magnet for so-called digital nomads
PAUSE
…it’s where a young foreigner found opportunity..
PAUSE
… and the hope of a new life…
PAUSE
… until a shocking case of justice delayed… threw it into turmoil…
TRANSITION.. something to take you OUT OF intro/OPENING MODE.. into the healtath conscious/healthy Paulo
VO: Portuguese French National Paulo de Barros, was dispatched to the Cape Town office of an international tech company.
UPS: so i was sent to south africa in twenty seventeen basically creating browsers, where internet becomes less expensive for people with lower disposable income
VO: Health conscience and active, Cape Town fit him like a glove…

Paulo: i was someone that was very active spending time with family and a lot of friends and enjoying life. i was once a soccer player, a break dancer and as of late i was a triathlete doing a lot of iron man's. I like challenges and this is who I was.

NEW VO: That life… now… just a memory.

VISUAL TRANSITION… dip to black to SIGNIFY SAD TRANSITION
PAUSE.. avoid back to back VO/link

PAULO WAS THRIVING IN HIS NEW LIFE… BUT AFTER 2 YEARS.. AN INEXPLICABLE ALTERCATION BROUGHT IT ALL THAT TO A CRASHING HALT…
VO: It took place at a house party in Bantry Bay. The Atlantic seaboard consists of plush, mountainside suburbs with homes to some of Cape Town's wealthiest residents, a playground for the city's elite"

VO: Paulo remembers arriving at the house party, but nothing else. He’s had to piece together what happened from people who were there that night. This shocking CCTV footage lays bare a brief but brutal assault. It left Paulo unconscious on the ground.

VIZ: footage showing him being punched

Paulo: That's where he broke my nose and skull at this moment, he hit me again, I was unconscious, unable to defend myself, but he’s not finished, he comes back.
VO: William Booth is one of Cape Town’s best-known criminal lawyers. Incidents like this, he says, often result in charges far more serious than just assault.
Booth: Attempted murder is also interlinked with assault or with assault with intent. Because if you beating somebody up with your fists, you kicking them that could also indicate intention to kill the person.
Paulo: When I woke up I was very disorientated, I had bleeding inside my brain in multiple place, I had my skull fractured all the way from here all the way up here (shows us). I remember the staff saying that someone has tried to kill me.
see Richard first before the VO kicks in

VO: A friend, Richard Mantle, received a call saying Paulo was in a critical condition in hospital.
Claire: When was the first time that you could see him?
Richard: When I picked him up about 8 days later. He basically came back and stayed here. 19/20 hours a day lying in the fetal position.
Paulo described living with an elephant in his head, as if external sounds were leaking into his skull.

LINK: IMAGINE YOU CAN’T VISIT PUBLIC SPACES .. BECAUSE YOU CAN LITERALLY FEEL EVERY BIT OF NOISE IN YOUR BRAIN ..LISTEN.. 10-15 SECONDS OF NOISE…

Paulo: I couldn't go anywhere, the noise of the outside was making me sick.

VO: He flew back to France for specialist medical care. Paulo’s fracture never healed, leaving him with debilitating symptoms his doctors hadn’t seen before. In March, doctors operated on Paulo’s skull.

Video Diary… Paulo: Arrived at the hospital, this is my mom and uncle, this is it.

VO: The surgeons reached Paulo’s skull from an incision behind his ear, delicately working on the fracture.

Paulo: they basically resurface everything and then they cover it with bone and plug it so then there is no more leakage.
IT’S BEEN 2 AND A HALF YEARS SINCE PAULO WAS ASSAULTED.. A HARROWING JOURNEY BACK FROM THE BRINK… BUT WHAT ABOUT JUSTICE FOR THE BRAZEN ATTACK? IF YOU LOOK AT THE FOOTAGE THE ASSAILANT IS CLEAR.

WHY WOULD THE MAN PUNCH HIM.. AND KICK HIM.. WHILE HE’S LYING, ALREADY UNCONSCIOUS, ON THE GROUND? THESE WERE QUESTIONS PAULO WAS ASKING HIMSELF AS WELL…
VIZ TRANSITION TO THE FACEBOOK IMAGES
VO:
But, his search for answers led nowhere: an investigating officer even saying there was NO incident to investigate! That’s despite Paulo’s injuries and the CCTV footage. Increasingly frustrated, Paulo hired a private investigator who collected 10 witness statements pointing to a quiet night with no hint of the violence to come: people were having fun mingling, with no sign of disagreements or arguments, said one. Another described a pleasant, peaceful evening.

Screen Grabs: “People were having fun mingling, I did not notice any disagreements or arguments.” (kera booysen) “It was a pleasant, peaceful evening,”(rahma robertson)...

VO: Astonishingly, of the more than 30 people there that night, none claims to have seen the incident. (BRIEF PAUSE) But the CCTV evidence leads witnesses to point fingers at this man: Gino Sanchez.

VO: A 25-year old from Johannesburg, and unknown to Paulo, Sanchez attended St John’s College, one of the city’s top private schools. Well travelled, judging by his social media, he’s clearly close to his father, Jo Sanchez… CEO of a major company...and someone we would get to know later. (BUILD IN A VO PAUSE HERE)

FILM CLAIRE WITH TRANSITION BACK TO THE WITNESS STATEMENTS & VIDEO

VO: So, there were witness statements, crucial CCTV footage, and an alleged perpetrator. And yet, astonishingly, the National Prosecuting Authority declined to take up the case.

PAUSE

VO: Paulo, though, wasn’t backing down. He turned to William Booth to fight his case.
BOOTHS INTERVIEW: I then took the matter one step higher as it were to the Director Public Prosecutions in the Western Cape who reviewed the case and they decided to prosecute
NEW VO: That was 2 years ago!
AFTER SEVERAL MONTHS, PAULO DE BARROS RECEIVED NEWS THAT THE NPA HAD CHANGED ITS MIND AND DECIDED TO PROSECUTE A CASE OF ATTEMPTED MURDER AGAINST GINO SANCHEZ, BUT THAT DIDN’T MEAN HE WOULD BE ARRESTED, AND ALMOST 2 YEARS LATER HE’S YET TO APPEAR IN COURT.

VO: Richard was a bystander to this comedy of errors.

RICHARD: I was told that this Gino Sanchez guy was going to be in court and I stood there for 6 or 7 hours and was eventually told actually this SUBPOENA hadn't been served.

VO Again Booth stepped in, demanding action from the authorities.

William booth: An application was made by the prosecutors to a magistrate for a warrant for the arrest, as we speak the police at Seapoint are in the process of looking for the perpetrator to have him arrested.
VO: Booth needs to convince the judge that Gino had INTENDED harming Paulo… two of the witness statements may show this.

VO: “Gino said he would smack him if he didn’t stop following him.’ says one. Another claims, “Gino was very agitated, and said he was going to smack de Barros.”


VO: Gino Sanchez is being sued by Paulo in civil court, too. That’s where we found his version of events. He says, “The plaintiff was the antagonist in the altercation…” claiming Paulo bumped him aggressively to PROVOKE a reaction. Swore at, abused and crowded him… followed him outside, and threatened him.

Gino claims IT WAS self-defence, and that his conduct was reasonable.
Paulo: I have to disagree, I was ambushed, I'm not aggressive, respectful of everyone and anyone.


VO: We called Gino to ask him FOR HIS SIDE OF THE STORY .

Claire: I’d like to request an interview with you, Gino…

Please, about the assault on Mr Paulo de Barros?

Gino: “ About an assault?”

Claire: “You hit… you assaulted Mr Paulo de Barros?
Do you remember that?”

Gino: Yes I remember that, can I please give you my lawyer's email…


Gino’s father, Jo, interrupted…

C: Who am I speaking to?

01: 19: Mr Sanchez.

C: We want to request an interview with
Gino Sanchez about the assault on Mr Paulo de Barros?

Father: Is that the 38-year-old
that was at a 22-year-old’s party?



C: It doesn’t matter what their age is…
but he’s been assaulted,
and has brain damage from that assault.

Father: Unfortunately, we are in the process legally of a…
so that won’t be possible…
we are fighting and defending it,
like Mr de Barros.

If my lawyers are okay to do the interview,
then happily, Gino will do the interview,
there’s nothing to hide.

Bye-bye.

CLAIRE TO CAMERA: A father stepping in to defend his son, gino hardly said a word in that call…hardly a word he said before his father swooped in and shut things down.

VO: In a letter sent AFTER OUR PHONE CALL, Sanchez’s lawyers said their clients COULDN’T do an interview as it WOULD PREJUDICE THEIR CASE.. THEY CLAIMED WE HAD an agenda, and SAID THAT PAULO HAD THREATENED THEM.

They EMPHASISED their client acted in self-defence and warned of legal action IF WE BROADCAST THIS story.


Claire: Is it unusual for a case that seems quite clear cut to take so long?
Booth: It shouldn’t take so long, both the victim and an accused in a criminal matter should want the matter to be finalized quickly.
FOR PAULO, IT’S ABOUT justice, AND HIS DAY IN COURT

Paulo: Life is unfair sometimes, but you have to believe that things will get better and this is what i've done. You can have all the wealth, but if you have no health of integrity whats the point then.

Increasingly frustrated, Paulo hired a private investigator who collected 10 witness statements pointing to a quiet night with no hint of the violence to come: people were having fun mingling, with no sign of disagreements or arguments, said one. Another described a pleasant, peaceful evening. Screen Grabs: “People were having fun mingling, I did not notice any disagreements or arguments.” (kera booysen) “It was a pleasant, peaceful evening,”(rahma robertson)... VO: Astonishingly, of the more than 30 people there that night, none claims to have seen the incident. (BRIEF PAUSE) But the CCTV evidence leads witnesses to point fingers at this man: Gino Sanchez. VO: A 25-year old from Johannesburg, and unknown to Paulo, Sanchez attended St John’s College, one of the city’s top private schools. Well travelled, judging by his social media, he’s clearly close to his father, Jo Sanchez… CEO of a major company...and someone we would get to know later. (BUILD IN A VO PAUSE HERE) FILM CLAIRE WITH TRANSITION BACK TO THE WITNESS STATEMENTS & VIDEO VO: So, there were witness statements, crucial CCTV footage, and an alleged perpetrator. And yet, astonishingly, the National Prosecuting Authority declined to take up the case. PAUSE VO: Paulo, though, wasn’t backing down. He turned to William Booth to fight his case. BOOTHS INTERVIEW: I then took the matter one step higher as it were to the Director Public Prosecutions in the Western Cape who reviewed the case and they decided to prosecute NEW VO: That was 2 years ago! AFTER SEVERAL MONTHS, PAULO DE BARROS RECEIVED NEWS THAT THE NPA HAD CHANGED ITS MIND AND DECIDED TO PROSECUTE A CASE OF ATTEMPTED MURDER AGAINST GINO SANCHEZ, BUT THAT DIDN’T MEAN HE WOULD BE ARRESTED, AND ALMOST 2 YEARS LATER HE’S YET TO APPEAR IN COURT. VO: Richard was a bystander to this comedy of errors. RICHARD: I was told that this Gino Sanchez guy was going to be in court and I stood there for 6 or 7 hours and was eventually told actually this SUBPOENA hadn't been served. VO Again Booth stepped in, demanding action from the authorities. William booth: An application was made by the prosecutors to a magistrate for a warrant for the arrest, as we speak the police at Seapoint are in the process of looking for the perpetrator to have him arrested. VO: Booth needs to convince the judge that Gino had INTENDED harming Paulo… two of the witness statements may show this. VO: “Gino said he would smack him if he didn’t stop following him.’ says one. Another claims, “Gino was very agitated, and said he was going to smack de Barros.” VO: Gino Sanchez is being sued by Paulo in civil court, too. That’s where we found his version of events. He says, “The plaintiff was the antagonist in the altercation…” claiming Paulo bumped him aggressively to PROVOKE a reaction. Swore at, abused and crowded him… followed him outside, and threatened him. Gino claims IT WAS self-defence, and that his conduct was reasonable. Paulo: I have to disagree, I was ambushed, I'm not aggressive, respectful of everyone and anyone. VO: We called Gino to ask him FOR HIS SIDE OF THE STORY . Claire: I’d like to request an interview with you, Gino… Please, about the assault on Mr Paulo de Barros? Gino: “ About an assault?” Claire: “You hit… you assaulted Mr Paulo de Barros? Do you remember that?” Gino: Yes I remember that, can I please give you my lawyer's email… Gino’s father, Jo, interrupted… C: Who am I speaking to? 01: 19: Mr Sanchez. C: We want to request an interview with Gino Sanchez about the assault on Mr Paulo de Barros? Father: Is that the 38-year-old that was at a 22-year-old’s party? C: It doesn’t matter what their age is… but he’s been assaulted, and has brain damage from that assault. Father: Unfortunately, we are in the process legally of a… so that won’t be possible… we are fighting and defending it, like Mr de Barros. If my lawyers are okay to do the interview, then happily, Gino will do the interview, there’s nothing to hide. Bye-bye. CLAIRE TO CAMERA: A father stepping in to defend his son, gino hardly said a word in that call…hardly a word he said before his father swooped in and shut things down. VO: In a letter sent AFTER OUR PHONE CALL, Sanchez’s lawyers said their clients COULDN’T do an interview as it WOULD PREJUDICE THEIR CASE.. THEY CLAIMED WE HAD an agenda, and SAID THAT PAULO HAD THREATENED THEM. They EMPHASISED their client acted in self-defence and warned of legal action IF WE BROADCAST THIS story. Claire: Is it unusual for a case that seems quite clear cut to take so long? Booth: It shouldn’t take so long, both the victim and an accused in a criminal matter should want the matter to be finalized quickly. FOR PAULO, IT’S ABOUT justice, AND HIS DAY IN COURT Paulo: Life is unfair sometimes, but you have to believe that things will get better and this is what i've done. You can have all the wealth, but if you have no health of integrity whats the point then.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: Paulo de Barros is a French and Portuguese national. He came to South Africa in 2018 to work at a tech company providing internet access via Opera. They provided access specifically to those who cannot afford it – they became the browser of choice in Africa for 100m people. Then 2 years ago he was assaulted one evening in Bantry Bay, hit in the head and nearly died. • He sustained a skull fracture, brain hemorrhage, brain contusion and nose fracture – and permanent brain damage. He also had permanent hearing loss (Autophony – person's own speech or other self-generated noises (e.g. heartbeat, eye movements, creaking joints, chewing) are heard unusually loudly in the affected ear; Dizziness/ vertigo/ chronic disequilibrium caused by the dysfunction of the superior semicircular canal; Tullio phenomenon – sound-induced vertigo, disequilibrium or dizziness, nystagmus and oscillopsia; Pulse-synchronous oscillopsia; Hyperacusis – the over-sensitivity to sound; Extreme sound distortion ( broken stereo); A feeling of fullness in the affected ear, Pulsatile tinnitus; Brain fog ;Fatigue ;Headache/migraine; Tinnitus – high pitched ringing in the ear Brain damage This means for the past 2 years he couldnt anywhere where there is noise, noise became his “handicap, it's everywhere. I haven't been able to travel, socialize or even go to restaurants or malls without suffering… I simplify cannot live a normal life since then. I basically do nothing all day and most of the days besides sitting at home and working in front of my computer… Since then I have had a limited life, reduced to being always alone where there is no noise.” He knew something was wrong, but no one listened to him, so he went to France to see a specialist and he was then diagnosed with Semicircular canal dehiscence (SCD) which is a crack of the fracture that never healed, sustained by the attack which is the root/source of all the problems. I am now awaiting for surgery from a Professor in Belgium. This is so rare, that he is likely the only person currently living with this extreme rare disorder – most people are sent into a vegetative state. The surgery requires the doctors to open his skull, fill in the gap with a bony material taken from other parts of his skull to plug the defect and then resurface the area. Then his skull is glued back together. The recovery for this is a month – he will be put into a coma, and then woken up. You can see the crack – very hard to diagnose His surgery is going to take place towards the end of March. And his life hangs in the balance. So how did this happen? And why? It all began that fateful night when he was assaulted. Obviously in the hospital, Paulo was reliant on his friend and the police to investigate. Paulo’s friend said that the Sea Point Police officer assigned the case M. Mgolozeli denied that anything happened after visiting the house and was going to dismiss the case, but then Paulo hired a PI – Ben from Unisure who collected the video of the incident and got affidavits from all the witnesses present – all of which point the finger at one man. A 25 year old from St. Johns named Gino Sanchez. The video shows Gino walking up to de Barros (randomly) and gino punches him in the face, then twice more while he’s unconscious on the floor. For the 2 hours before the incident from when De Barros arrived, the two of them never spoke or interacted according to the CCTV we have. There was no explanation as to why Sanchez beat him. And none has been forthcoming.
metadata.Summary: Please view the video here: please watch in file Who is Gino? His father, Jo Sanchez, runs a construction company https://www.sanjo.co.za/ with alleged ties to organizations such as Cosatu https://www.sanjo.co.za/clients/, who have a lot of political influence in South Africa. They live a life of luxury ferarri’s, yachts, trips to Greece… After the case and all evidence being collected including video footage of the assault and medical reports, the case was assigned to Prosecutor Mr David Jacobs. Despite the video evidence showing Gino, the affidavits confirming it was him, the prosecutor declined to prosecute without providing any reason. Then de Barros hired lawyer William Booth – well known criminal attorney. He questioned the NPA. Prosecutor David Jacobs then lost the docket, but then when he found out there were hard copies, the docket re-appeared. With Booth’s intervention the NPA decided to prosecute Gino for attempted murder on one count. (I have the email)… But its been over a year, and Gino still haven’t had his day in court, because they didn’t arrest him. They sent him a subpoena to appear in court, and the police say they haven’t been able to serve it on him because Gino is in Johannesburg – and doesn’t live in cape town. The police are just dragging their feet, and Booth has now asked for an arrest warrant – which is yet to be signed by the NPA. The PI is willing to speak, Booth, Charl Norman who was with de Barros is willing to speak, we have the affidavits of the witnesses and we can call them (ive been hesitant because these kids are gino’s social group – despite them giving evidence saying he did it) We would obviously confront Gino – we know where he lives. But his dad’s house is in a complex near sandton city. We have MANY pictures of Gino and his family. All the evidence and affidavits is in the folder provided.
